title: Memory management and garbage collection — concept map
intro: Stack vs heap, V8 generational GC (Scavenge, mark-sweep-compact), closure retention, WeakRef, leak patterns, detached DOM, DevTools profiling, and V8 vs CLR comparison.

overviewDiagram.title: V8 generational GC overview

conceptCards.title: Stack, heap, references
conceptCards.summary: Primitives and references on stack. Objects on heap. References are pointers — assignment copies reference.
conceptCards.example: const a = { x: 1 }; const b = a;

conceptCards.title: V8 GC generations
conceptCards.summary: Young Scavenge frequent. Old mark-sweep-compact. Promotion after survival. Incremental marking reduces pause.

conceptCards.title: Closure retention
conceptCards.summary: Inner function keeps outer environment alive. Long-lived listener + large capture = leak.

conceptCards.title: WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry
conceptCards.summary: Weak references do not prevent GC. FinalizationRegistry callback after collect — not deterministic cleanup.

conceptCards.title: Leak patterns
conceptCards.summary: Forgotten timers, global caches, listeners not removed, closures over DOM.

conceptCards.title: Detached DOM
conceptCards.summary: Removed from tree but referenced by JS — heap snapshot shows Detached nodes.
conceptCards.example: SPA route change with lingering handler

conceptCards.title: DevTools profiling
conceptCards.summary: Heap snapshot compare. Allocation timeline. Filter Constructor and Retained size.

conceptCards.title: V8 vs CLR GC
conceptCards.summary: V8 single main-thread pauses. CLR server GC background threads. Both generational.

conceptCards.title: Allocation hot paths
conceptCards.summary: Reduce object churn in tight loops. Pool buffers in Node. Avoid per-request clients.
conceptCards.example: Singleton Redis client not per request
